text.MEALS-1: Meals are reimbursable up to $100 per line.
text.HOTEL-1: Hotel stays are reimbursable up to $300 per night.
text.TAXI-1: Ground transport up to $80 per trip.
text.TRAVEL-1: Flights and rail up to $1500 per booking.
text.SOFT-1: Software subscriptions up to $250 per line; above requires IT approval.
text.OFFICE-1: Office supplies up to $150 per line.
text.RECEIPT-1: A receipt is required for any line above $25.
text.RECEIPT-2: The receipt amount must match the claimed amount.
text.TRAVEL-3: Weekend travel (Sat/Sun) requires a business justification note.
